subject.title: fix(discord): add configurable REST API timeout

question: Should OpenClaw accept `channels.discord.apiTimeoutMs` as a supported Discord config key for normal and monitor REST calls?
rationale: The code path looks coherent, but root policy treats new config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive and the config/env surface bar is intentionally high, so maintainers must own the public contract.

options.title: Accept After Refresh
options.body: Resolve conflicts, rerun checks on the exact head, and accept `apiTimeoutMs` as the supported Discord REST timeout config surface.

options.title: Defer The Public Knob
options.body: Pause or close the timeout-config branches if maintainers prefer internal timeout/retry tuning instead of another supported config key.

options.title: Require Live Discord Proof
options.body: Keep the implementation direction but ask for live Discord large-guild or rate-limit proof before merge if local RequestClient proof is not enough.

recommendation.title: Accept After Refresh
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, rerun checks on the exact head, and accept `apiTimeoutMs` as the supported Discord REST timeout config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for Discord REST/client/monitor ownership is recent work by steipete on these same files and timeout/default behavior.
